widget.prompt: A bowl has 3 red grapes and 4 green grapes. Show the total.

commonCounts.feedback: That counts the red grapes only. Both colors are in the same bowl.

widget.missFeedback: Fill one square at a time, counting as you go, until the frame shows the number you need.

predict.prompt: A bowl has 3 red grapes and 4 green grapes. Did anything join or leave the bowl?

options.label: Neither — both parts were already there

predict.reveal: Put-together stories have no action: the two parts already sit in one bowl, and counting them names the whole.
